messages:
sara_fin: FYI: Kestrel Labs invoice INV-2029-078 for $42,300.00 failed ACH on 2024-03-18 — bank return R03. They flagged a PO mismatch. Need a decision: retry / short payment plan / escalate. Billing notes show a soft dunning sent yesterday.

billing-bot: Automated dunning email sent to billing@kestrel.com at 2217305125. Next automated retry scheduled in 48h.

eli_sales: Can we hold off escalation? Kestrel told my AE they'd wire next week but their AP needs a PO to release. We could offer a 2-part installment with a signed addendum.

tom_ops: ACH retry recorded as failed once. I can schedule 2 more retries (48h apart) and create a one-time pay link. Command I ran locally:
```
# create pay link (example)
/billing create-link INV-2029-078 amount=42300 expire_days=7
```

sara_fin: Do that — queue the 2 retries and create the pay link with 7d expiry. If no response after 7d, recommend adding a 10% late fee and escalating. Seeking quick thumbs from legal/sales.

maria_legal: Heads up — contract SOW §4.2 requires a 30-day cure notice before collections. Recommend: send a formal notice quoting the SOW excerpt, cc legal, and wait 14 days from notice before switching to external collections (we can shorten internally but external 3rd-party needs the notice).

michelle_csr: I'll draft the formal notice now; include invoice PDF, ledger, and available payment methods (ACH, wire, card). Will post copy here once sent.

eli_sales: If they accept partial payment, sales can accept a 50/50 split with signed addendum and ensure product access remains unchanged. We will own collection on our side.

sara_fin: Agreed plan: 1) queue ACH retries, 2) create & send pay link, 3) send formal notice (cc legal), 4) if no response within 14 days of notice escalate to collections. Michelle — attach invoice PDF and ledger snapshot.

billing-bot: Payment link created: https://pay.redwood.example/lnk/abc123 (expires in 7 days) :white_check_mark:

michelle_csr: Formal notice sent at 2217306000 to billing@kestrel.com, legal@kestrel.com. Email subject: "Formal Notice: Past Due Invoice INV-2029-078 per SOW 4.2". Included SOW excerpt, invoice PDF, ledger export, and payment options. Copy excerpt below:
> Per SOW §4.2, customer shall cure payment within thirty (30) days of invoice receipt. Failure to cure may result in interest and collections.

sara_fin: Thanks. Logging ticket ESCALATE-INV-2029-078. I will mark for collections if we have no payment confirmation by 2217306400.

eli_sales: I'll also reach out to their CFO first thing tomorrow to nudge — ping me if legal wants me to loop their procurement contact.

maria_legal: One more note: if they raise a usage dispute, capture it in writing and do NOT withhold undisputed portions. Document dispute items before agreeing to adjustments.

sara_fin: Noted and ack. Will update thread when we get status. :thumbsup:
